PFContract.Objective: Compile a complete, implementable, auditable application specification—not executable code—for a synthetic USD transaction reconciliation ledger API using exact financial arithmetic, atomic PostgreSQL persistence, strict validation, idempotence, concurrency safety, and demonstrable failures.
